taser.caption: Taser, then Golden Chip
rows: Caller
Name the table before anyone pulls an item out. Roulette, Blackjack, Street Craps, and the wheels are the ones where a higher cap matters.
If the crew is still walking, nobody activates anything.
Taser holder
Stand at that keypad. Hold the Taser on it. A full contact is described as about 10 seconds and a 5x max bet. Letting go early leaves charge for a second machine.
Zapping a keypad you are not going to bet is a wasted raise.
Chip holder
Use the Golden Chip on that same machine. It bets the current maximum and does not take money for the bet.
Using the chip first locks the free all-in to the old, smaller cap.
Timer
When the result lands, stop. One planned swing is the combo.
A second all-in “because we’re hot” is how the free money goes back.

mistakes.caption: Why the item “did nothing”
rows: Time Machine gave the money back and then took a win
It reverses the whole last 60 seconds, not just your personal loss.
Call the net of that minute first. Fire it only on a team loss. It will not arm in the lobby.
Camera balance hit zero
The lens was on when someone lost, or it was pointed at a machine instead of a head.
Keep it off. Film the other player’s head at the win, then smash the camera to cash out. It cannot film you.
Holy Statue did not shield anyone
People were spread out, or they kept betting after the window.
Group at the table, activate, bet the fast games, stop when it ends.
Taser + chip paid a small free bet
Chip was used before the Taser finished, or on a different keypad.
Taser first, same keypad, then chip.
Bought item, no effect
It was paid for and never picked up, or it was used on the wrong target.
E to pick it up in the shop. Keypad items touch a keypad. Aura items need the holder standing with the crew.
Stake Holder felt useless
No other item was in play, or you expected it to buff the Time Machine.
It amplifies other items. It does not buff the Time Machine.
